instruction: Repair or initialize the explicitly selected AutoDL OpenGU runtime environment using the project's current environment guidance. This action may install CUDA/Python dependencies only when invoked by name; it must not run as part of routine deploy.
preconditions: Confirm bootstrap was explicitly requested, the active checkout is /autodl-fs/data/OpenGU, and the remote GPU/CUDA/Python baseline has been observed rather than guessed.
Confirm a recoverable environment plan and enough remote storage exist before installing or removing dependencies.
readBack: Read back the selected Python environment, CUDA/PyTorch compatibility, required package imports and one project preflight. Report bootstrap verified only when those exact checks pass; do not claim that any experiment has run.
